status: CP AUDIT, TWO PARTS. (1) MIRROR-PRESERVING EXTENSIONS SUPPLY NO PHASE: the exact matter-antimatter mirror (+- pairing of the 32-level spectrum, Theorem 4) is preserved by the V65 Wilson extension (base dev 2.4e-15, V71 regression), and the mirror is exactly the structure forcing every CP-odd invariant to vanish - every mirror-preserving extension leaves W5's CP phase at zero. (2) EVERY CLASS-DEPENDENT DRESSING BREAKS THE ONE-CELL MIRROR: the most general per-class kappa_s diagonal (both mirror sign conventions: 9.7e-01, 2.9e+00) and the most general real-symmetric off-diagonal bond generator (both conventions: 1.2e+00, 1.5e+00) destroy the +- pairing over 60 draws (combined 1.0e+00); extensions unitary to 2.7e-14. The V96 bond layer therefore either (a) acts only in the BOND layer, where the mirror test must be redone at the lattice level (open), or (b) breaks Theorem 4 - the theory's cleanest structural result - and buys a CP phase at that named cost. W5 additionally needs the out-of-equilibrium dynamics V106 showed the thermal route lacks.

data.verdict: mirror-preserving extensions supply no CP phase; one-cell class-dependent dressings break the mirror
